## Jovunara Pilates — New Year Free Trial campaign recap

**Flight:** Wed Jan 6 – Fri Jan 8, 2027 (Dhaka time), ended on schedule and is now `EXPIRED` / not serving.

**What I ran:** One campaign with two ad groups, both optimized for **link clicks to the landing page**:
- Worldwide **excluding China**
- **iPhone / iOS only**
- Objective: Website Clicks (pay per link click)

Soon after launch I shifted daily budget toward the better-performing creative (Post 2138877881350341546). I left the other post running but at a lower share; both ended up spending close to plan.

### Results (X-reported, campaign totals)

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Spend | **$643.89** (of $650 budget) |
| Impressions | **1,110,725** |
| Link clicks | **1,116** |
| CTR | ~0.10% |
| Avg. cost per link click | ~$0.58 |

**By ad group / post:**
- **Post 2138877881350341546** ("iPhone (iOS) only; worldwide except China…"): $389.15 spend, 594,857 impressions, 703 link clicks (0.118% CTR, $0.55 CPC)
- **Post 2139059075284323251** ("Give your New Year resolution a starting date…"): $254.74 spend, 515,868 impressions, 413 link clicks (0.080% CTR, $0.62 CPC)

### Important note on what the reporting can and cannot show
Your site has no X pixel, so **X cannot see trial starts, landing-page visits, or any on-site conversion**. The numbers above are **impressions and link clicks only** — there is no trial-start count, cost per trial, or conversion rate available in X's reporting.
